PullRequest.Title: agentHost: Measure discovery result processing and registration
PullRequest.Body:

Follow-up to #338206: distinguish provider enumeration from processed discovery results and host registration for the Agent Host Performance dashboard.

## Changes

- Add `firstSessionDiscoveryResult` for Copilot, Claude, and Codex after processing and synchronous candidate emission, including observed empty results.
- Add bounded `sessionDiscoveryRegistrationStart` / `sessionDiscoveryRegistration` observations and an independent `firstSessionDiscoveryRegistration` milestone, with observed candidate, external, registered, filtered, failed, and incomplete counts.
- Preserve schema version 1, consent, provider activation decisions, scan boundaries, retry/concurrency behavior, and existing error handling. No additional enumeration, storage reads, timers, or blocking waits.
- Isolate telemetry bookkeeping in focused helpers and document the boundaries and dashboard interpretation in `PERFORMANCE.md`.

Registration ends after scheduling, **not awaiting**, publication reconciliation. These markers do not claim UI rendering or global completion across providers. Scan and registration attempts must not be paired with one another; missing observations remain distinct from empty results.

## Validation

Passed: **173 targeted telemetry and discovery regression tests**:

```bash
env -u COPILOT_HOME ./scripts/test.sh \
  --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/agentHostStartupPerformance.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/agentService.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/claudeAgent.test.ts \
  --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/codex/codexChatDiscovery.test.ts \
  --grep 'AgentHostStartupPerformance|startup telemetry|[Dd]iscover' \
  --reporter dot
```

- `npm run gulp compile-client` — passed, 0 errors.
- `npm run typecheck-client` — passed.
- `npm run eslint -- $(git diff --cached --name-only -- '*.ts')` — passed on all 12 changed TypeScript files, run before committing.
- `git diff --cached --check` — passed.
- Numeric/boolean telemetry classification audit — all 33 measurement fields passed.

The broader `npm run compile-client` command also builds extensions and failed because this isolated worktree lacks the unrelated `esbuild` dependency used by `extensions/esbuild-common.mts`. The core-only compile command above succeeded. Full extension builds and provider end-to-end tests were not completed.

Scenarios.Scenario: First external-session discovery result for Copilot, Claude, or Codex during early migration-enabled startup or deferred post-startup discovery
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing provider catalog enumeration and per-session classification must finish before the new first-result marker is recorded. Candidate batches are synchronously emitted first; telemetry is synchronously enqueued afterward but no telemetry flush is awaited. In the normal external-session path discovery starts only after startup settles, so this work is off the host startup critical path; legacy migration enablement can start it earlier.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Copilot SDK sessions.list RPC followed by existing metadata/project reads during classification
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One list RPC per discovery pass; per-session classification is bounded to concurrency 4 and emitted in batches of at most 250
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same SDK enumeration and classification ran before this PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required before Copilot discovery can emit candidates; unchanged by the diff

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Claude SDK listSessions and existing known-session metadata checks
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One SDK list per attempt, with per-session checks at concurrency 4; retries are pre-existing and bounded
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same SDK enumeration and metadata checks ran before this PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required before Claude emits the result; unchanged by the diff

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One to at most 50 page requests per scan, coalesced for concurrent migration/discovery callers
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same paginated app-server enumeration ran before this PR.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required before Codex maps and emits changed chats; unchanged by the diff

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Queue one agentHost.startupMark telemetry event for the first processed discovery result
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one first-result event per normalized provider for the host lifetime; zero when usage telemetry and trace logging are disabled
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No first-result telemetry event was enqueued.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The small event is synchronously handed to the telemetry service after candidate emission, with no awaited flush

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Provider catalog size. Copilot classifies in batches of 250 with limiters of 4; Claude classifies its listed catalog with concurrency 4; Codex reads up to 50 catalog pages and maps top-level threads. The added count is one linear pass over only the first result's emitted candidates (or constant-time lengths for Claude), after existing classification.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Copilot discovery is serialized by a Sequencer and uses per-stage limiters of 4. Claude has one cached discovery promise and a limiter of 4. Codex coalesces scans through CodexChatDiscovery and _codexChatList, with metadata caching and scheduled invalidation. Providers may run independently.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Copilot's discovered-signature map suppresses unchanged emissions; Codex coalesces an in-flight list and reuses keyed metadata while its watcher/safety refresh controls rescans; Claude's successful discovery promise prevents repeat startup scans. The first-result milestone is normalized and retained once per provider bucket, including when telemetry is disabled, so warm passes neither recount nor replay it.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: provider call paths, batching, coalescing, and the one-shot isPending guard are explicit in the changed and surrounding code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact catalog sizes and telemetry enqueue duration vary, but the added work is one bounded marker plus a single linear count over already-loaded first-result candidates, not another enumeration or metadata read.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff adds bounded in-memory counting and one non-awaited telemetry marker without increasing SDK, filesystem, database, retry, or scan cardinality.

Scenarios.Scenario: Host registration of provider discovery batches and subsequent external-session publication
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After the existing per-provider promise queue and any forced migration, registration awaits three registry snapshots and existing per-candidate registration/catalog synchronization. The new timing wraps that same work. Session-list publication reconciliation is scheduled with awaitReconciliation=false and remains off the measured registration critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Load runtime-compatible keys, modified times, and provider exclusions, then perform existing per-candidate registry/catalog reads and writes plus batch post-processing writes
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Three parallel snapshots per emitted batch; per-candidate work scales with effective batch size at concurrency 4, with existing batched post-processing writes
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The identical snapshot, registration, synchronization, and post-processing boundaries already ran for every discovery batch.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: These existing operations determine registration latency; the diff only records counters around them

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Queue registration start/end markers and the first-success milestone through publicLog2
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Normally three small events on first successful registration; at most three start/end attempt pairs plus one eventual first-success event per normalized provider (seven total), and none without consent
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Registration did not emit these telemetry markers.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Events are synchronously enqueued but never flushed or awaited; publication reconciliation is still merely scheduled

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Received batch size after provider deduplication: Copilot batches are at most 250; Claude emits unknown chats in one batch (including an existing empty batch); Codex emits only changed chats. Added metrics perform one external-flag reduction and constant-time counter increments during existing candidate processing while an operation attempt or first successful milestone is pending.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Batches are strictly serialized per provider by _providerDiscoveryRegistrations; different providers can progress independently. Candidate registration remains limited to 4 within each batch. The diff adds no parallel database work or aggregate burst.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Registry snapshots and provider deduplication remain authoritative. Timing stops after the first success or three attempts; first-success accounting remains pending through partial/error attempts, then is consumed once. With telemetry disabled the operation and milestone are consumed without metric aggregation or later replay; after a warm successful observation, later batches skip all added aggregation.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the event listener's promise chain proves per-provider serialization, the existing Limiter proves candidate concurrency 4, and operation/milestone state proves bounded telemetry cardinality.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Database cost and batch size vary by catalog, but those boundaries are pre-existing. Added CPU is linear only in already-processed candidates and telemetry payload/event cardinality is fixed.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The PR neither fans out expensive boundaries nor moves publication onto the critical path; its added allocation, counters, and telemetry calls are bounded and disabled after observation.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all 14 changed files and relevant provider/registration call paths. No high-confidence performance regression was introduced, and the PR does not itself fix a concrete prior performance regression requiring blame attribution.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
